cost_model: Observed native bid/ask side-correct fills plus extra round-trip cost stresses 0, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 pair pips; primary +1 pip.
falsification_gates: minimum 1000 discovery legs and 500 active dates
minimum 600 confirmation legs and 300 active dates
net R positive and PF_R >=1.05 in discovery and confirmation at +1 pip
net R positive and PF_R >=1.00 in discovery and confirmation at +2 pips
at least 3/4 discovery years positive; no year contributes over 70% of discovery net R
28-day circular bootstrap lower 95% bound >0, 10000 replicates, seed 323
historical_contamination: 2017-2025 has prior project exposure; no historical pass alone would establish funded readiness.
hypothesis: At 12:00 UTC, the strongest and weakest foreign currencies by 5-active-weekday-session USD-relative return predict a same-day continuation move that survives one-hour signal delay and executable bid/ask fills.
preoutcome_amendments: Exclude UTC weekends from active signal/lookback/risk sessions; retain raw weekend bars.
Normalize pandas datetime indexes to nanoseconds for gap detection.
selection_rule: Single locked configuration; top/bottom currency rank; alphabetic currency-code tie break; no parameter optimization.
